queries.sql:
SELECT
        COALESCE(a.account_code, b.account_code) AS account_code,
        COALESCE(a.period, b.period) AS period,
        a.amount AS value_a,
        b.amount AS value_b,
        COALESCE(b.amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.amount, 0) AS variance,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.amount, 0) != 0
             THEN ROUND(((COALESCE(b.amount, 0) - a.amount) / ABS(a.amount)) * 100, 2)
             ELSE NULL END AS variance_pct
      FROM CUBE_FACT a
      FULL OUTER JOIN CUBE_FACT b
        ON a.account_code = b.account_code AND a.period = b.period
        AND a.entity = b.entity AND a.bu = b.bu
      WHERE a.version = 'actuals' AND b.version = 'aop-fy26' 
      ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(b.amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.amount, 0)) DESC
      LIMIT 500
